headline: Micron introduces global profit-linked bonus plan after union pressure
summary: Micron Technology will introduce a global, quarterly profit-linked bonus scheme starting in fiscal 2027 following union negotiations in Taiwan. The program will distribute half of its payouts in cash and half in stock based on net profits minus projected capital expenditures. The decision reflects growing pressure across the semiconductor industry to share financial gains from the artificial intelligence boom with employees.

headline: Uber rolls out AI training and productivity tools to 30,000 employees
summary: Uber is expanding an AI-powered productivity platform to over 30,000 global employees following a 1,000-person pilot across key business functions. The initiative provides dedicated training, integrations with common workplace apps, and an internal AI skills library to automate complex tasks like data analysis and meeting preparation. Partnering with OpenAI on the deployment, Uber intends to track and share insights on adoption metrics and productivity outcomes as the rollout progresses.

headline: Wingify appoints Sahil Sharma as global CPO
summary: Wingify has appointed Sahil Sharma as its global Chief People Officer, effective October 2026, to oversee the company's global people strategy and talent development. Sharma joins from RateGain, where he spent a decade in senior leadership roles, including Group CHRO, navigating HR transformations, cross-border M&As, and an IPO. He brings extensive HR and business experience from previous roles at IndiaMART InterMESH and Serco, with an emphasis on AI-driven HR processes.

headline: iD Fresh introduces entrepreneurship policy, offers employees sabbaticals of up to 18 months
summary: iD Fresh Food has launched an entrepreneurship policy allowing employees to take part-paid sabbaticals of up to 18 months to launch their own business ventures. Selected staff will receive mentorship, access to investor networks, and the option to return to their positions at the company if they choose. The initiative aims to support ethical business creation and foster professional growth beyond traditional corporate advancement.

headline: Enterprise-ready payroll: The real test is how it handles exceptions
summary: True enterprise-ready payroll software is defined by its ability to handle complex operational exceptions rather than just scaling to high employee headcounts. Standardized platforms often force organizations into manual, offline spreadsheet workarounds when dealing with diverse pay cycles, structures, and localized compliance requirements. Consequently, effective enterprise solutions must offer deep configurability to mirror actual business operations without increasing administrative friction.

headline: Hunar.AI secures Rs 40 crore to transform frontline workforce management
summary: Frontline workforce management startup Hunar.AI has raised Rs 40 crore in a Series A funding round led by Blume Ventures, bringing its total capital raised to Rs 65 crore. The company develops multilingual conversational AI tools designed to streamline high-volume hiring, training, and retention for sectors like retail and logistics. Hunar.AI will use the fresh capital to enhance its AI infrastructure, develop new products, and scale into new markets.

headline: What your first job teaches you that no classroom can
summary: While academic qualifications can help secure an entry-level position, real workplace success depends on soft skills, initiative, and navigating subtle organizational dynamics. HR leaders emphasize that early-career professionals should focus on bringing proactive solutions rather than just identifying problems, as well as managing stakeholders effectively outside formal meetings. Ultimately, early professional growth is best measured by developing sound judgment through challenging assignments rather than focusing solely on immediate titles or compensation.

headline: Will Barclays’ job cuts hit India amid AI push?
summary: Barclays is reducing its global workforce by approximately 5,000 employees as part of a £1.1 billion cost-cutting and AI-driven modernization initiative. The restructuring heavily impacts support and developer roles, significantly affecting back-office operations based in India. This move reflects a broader trend among major global banks using automation to streamline operations, drawing criticism from unions over the lack of employee reskilling.

headline: ‘Retaliation cannot override company policies’: Court
summary: A Bengaluru court ruled that Willis Towers Watson India Insurance Brokers unlawfully terminated a senior employee in retaliation for reporting financial irregularities. The court awarded the former executive over Rs 3.78 crore in damages and ordered perjury proceedings against two senior managers for concealing facts. The landmark judgment reinforces that corporate whistleblower and non-retaliation policies are legally binding commitments that cannot be bypassed using standard notice clauses.

headline: Finmart appoints Shweta M as group HR director
summary: Finmart has appointed Shweta M as its new Group Human Resources Director based in Dubai, effective October 2026. Bringing over 18 years of HR experience across sectors such as financial services, telecom, and aviation, she most recently led human resources for Policybazaar.ae in the UAE. In her new role, she will oversee talent acquisition, Emiratisation, employee engagement, and overall HR operations to support the company's growth.

headline: Kunal Lalani named chairman of AAAI’s North chapter
summary: The Advertising Agencies Association of India (AAAI) has appointed Kunal Lalani, managing director of The Crayons Network, as chairman of its newly established North India Chapter. Santosh Kumar, COO of Innocean Worldwide Communications, joins as co-chair to help lead the regional expansion. The chapter aims to drive agency growth, foster regional talent, and promote digital innovation across the North Indian market.

headline: Mindshare ends Wavemaker’s three-year EMVIES streak, wins Media Agency of the Year
summary: Mindshare secured the Best Media Agency of the Year title at the 2026 EMVIES Awards, ending a three-year streak by Wavemaker. Hindustan Unilever Limited was named Best Media Client of the Year, while WPP Media won Best Media Agency Network. Organized by The Advertising Club in Mumbai, the awards recognized excellence in media strategy, innovation, and effectiveness.

headline: The Unicorn Films & Walk The Talk Communications top the charts at afaqs! Foxglove Awards
summary: At the 12th afaqs! Foxglove Awards, The Unicorn Films was named Foxglove Star of the Year after leading the national tally with 10 awards. Walk The Talk Communications was awarded Foxglove Rising Star of the Year, while also leading regional tallies in the West and South. Other notable agency winners across regional and national categories included MagicCircle, Roll Dot Agency, and CoCreate Network.
